frigate.notes: Vstarcam's standard RTSP path (port 10554, /tcp/av0_0 main, /tcp/av0_1 sub); NOT restated on this product page. Enable RTSP/ONVIF in the VStarcam/Eye4 app and verify on device.

home_assistant.notes: Classic always-on Vstarcam IP camera; ONVIF/RTSP capable line. If ONVIF auto-discovery fails, add as generic RTSP with the port-10554 path above.

blue_iris.notes: Use the documented port-10554 RTSP path; select Generic/ONVIF.
